canonicalSource.idPolicy: Harness-assigned opaque 8-character IDs: collision-checked deterministic SHA256/base64url prefixes map EACH WHOLE generated structured bunch ID bijectively. Counters, run grouping, operation order, anchors and characters are identical to the structured replay. Not recorded collaborator identities; no refresh or regrouping.

source.attribution: Editing trace by Martin Kleppmann and the paper's authors, from automerge/automerge-perf. The upstream README states CC-BY-4.0 for the trace. Its concurrent history was flattened to index-based single-character edits; cursor moves are omitted.

upstreamVerification.method: JSON-literal extraction; upstream JavaScript never executed

measurement: Actual physical collection .wt file length / 100, including collection allocation/free space. All layouts use exactly the same {_id,state} wrapper. Index/shared-database files excluded. Logical BSON and network sizes not used.
gateMeaning: Measured gate on this fixture only: physical bytes must not exceed paired same-run F01 under the same compressor. This is not a universal storage ceiling guarantee for unseen documents or production migrations.
readiness: DS01/DS02/DS07/DS08 are leaf-only proposals; DS03 adds position navigation only. DS04/DS05/DS06 persist the specified complete navigation metadata, but their editing implementations, load work, typed-array conversion, and performance have NOT been built or measured. No hidden production IdList tree is assumed.
objective: Optimize lossless stored shape under the measured F01 ceiling. Cheap conversion to a different runtime is allowed and may be preferable. Persisted navigation indexes are optional cost counterexamples, NOT requirements for a winning storage format or the optimization target.
procedure: Fresh isolated localhost27186 MongoDB with dbPath/bind/port verified before writes; no database dropped
100 independently renamed whole-ID documents per layout, all opaque IDs exactly8chars and collisionchecked
Full exact SavedIdList roundtrip plus IdList validation for documents0/99; persisted indexes validated where present
Compact everycollection; fsync checkpoint; compact everycollection again; fsync with lock
Verify actual .wt file length equals storageSize and compressor matches requested value while locked; unlock afterward
caveats: Single uninterrupted canonical trace with harness-assigned IDs, not production corpus
One collection build per case, not statistical repeats; page allocations may produce ties
Identical run structure across independently renamed documents
Final snapshots freshly inserted, not Mongo update fragmentation
Metadata overhead is a paired compressed-file difference, not uncompressed metadata bytes; compression interactions may affect its sign

examples.readiness: Leaf pages only. No visible directory or identity index; runtime navigation construction remains unmeasured

examples.label: Explicit-counter pages + visible prefix ends
examples.readiness: Position-navigation metadata only: at(index) can use visibleEnds and page-local scans. Identity lookup remains linear without building a separate index. Not the fully indexed proposal

examples.label: Explicit-counter pages + complete navigation metadata
examples.readiness: Complete proposed navigation metadata: stable page IDs/order/positions, visible prefix ends, and whole-ID-to-page/row locations sorted by counter. Bounded within-page scans remain. Editing code and performance are NOT implemented or measured; immutable directory/index update costs remain to be evaluated.
